text:
maria: heads-up: deploybot scheduled a v2 split for /v1/chat -> /v2/chat at 2026-03-24T17:00Z. Staging found an SDK retry issue.

kevin: details?

maria: mobile SDK <=3.2.0 auto-retries on 429 without an idempotency key -> duplicate side-effects observed in staging.

mobile-eng: confirmed. Two tenants (T-314, T-271) depend on idempotent writes. SDK team can ship a patch with a retry toggle. ETA ~3h.

kevin: I propose: pause canary, pin those tenants to /v1/chat for 48h, enforce Idempotency-Key on v2 chat write endpoints, ship SDK fix, then resume.

deploybot: I can pin routes. Command: /deploybot pin-route --tenant T-314,T-271 --route /v1/chat --duration 48h --reason "legacy-sdk-retry"

anna: rollback thresholds suggestion: duplicate side-effect alerts >=0.5% OR p95 latency +15% -> auto-pause. Add to ops checklist.

maria: ops, add quick smoke probe: POST to /v2/chat with header Idempotency-Key: smoke-<uuid> run twice; first should be accepted, second should be flagged/409. Example curl: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v2/chat -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Idempotency-Key: smoke-123" -d '{"tenant":"T-314","message":"probe"}'

ops-bot: maintenance window extended on request. Deploybot pins applied in staging. Will apply to prod after manual confirm.

release-manager: drafting release note blurb: "v2 chat: recommend Idempotency-Key for writes. Mobile SDK <=3.2.0 users must upgrade to 3.2.1 or disable retry_on_throttle."

kevin: agreed. Action items: 1) @deploybot apply prod pin 2) @mobile-eng cut 3.2.1 with toggle 3) @maria/@anna add operator rollback checklist and probes 4) @release-manager publish advisory and tenant comms.

deploybot: applied prod pin at 6790012350.

mobile-eng: SDK 3.2.1 published. Tenants notified.

maria: staging probe results look good (duplicate detection working). We'll delay ramp until Monday quiet window. Reopen if we see flags. :white_check_mark:
